subject.title: Feature Request: Agent-triggered context compaction (self-compact tool)

question: Should models be allowed to request compaction of only their own active session through `session_status`, using the runner-controlled abort, compact, and resume path proposed by the linked PR?
rationale: Current policy deliberately restricts model-originated session mutation, while this capability cannot be accepted solely as a mechanical implementation detail because it changes when a model may terminate and rewrite its active context.

options.title: Approve current-session-only action
options.body: Accept the narrow action with fail-closed active-run wiring, no cross-session targeting, transcript cleanup, accounting updates, and focused security/recovery tests.

options.title: Keep compaction runtime-controlled
options.body: Reject model-triggered mutation and retain automatic, user-command, and operator-control-plane compaction as the only supported paths.

options.title: Defer to continuation design
options.body: Leave the focused action unlanded until the broader continuation and volitional-compaction direction is decided in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/85651.

recommendation.title: Approve current-session-only action
recommendation.body: Accept the narrow action with fail-closed active-run wiring, no cross-session targeting, transcript cleanup, accounting updates, and focused security/recovery tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository guidance identifies this person with compaction and Context Engine ownership, which is the central runtime and product boundary for the decision.
